quarterly_data.signal: Generac's 10-Q shows Commercial & Industrial segment capital expenditures of $46,412 (in thousands) in the three months ended June 30, 2026 versus $28,992 a year earlier, and $61,870 for the six months versus $42,080. Remaining performance obligations (excluding extended warranty, and excluding contracts with an original term of one year or less) were approximately $143,000 (in thousands) as of June 30, 2026, approximately 80% expected to be recognized within two years.
